note: Read 2026-11-01 at the owner's word ("Start the age readers once the ledger lands", the age rules reaching young writers, producers and directors as well as performers; "It should cover across every country"; "Again I want depth covering every basis for every feature leaving NO STONE UNTURNED"): what age changes for screen work in French Polynesia: the age of majority, the working age, how a minor's contract binds and what of the pay is set aside, a child performer's permit and hours, the unions', the funds' and the company law's ages. figures.finding: French Polynesia's support for film and audiovisual creation (SCCA, loi du pays 2021-20, reformed January 2026) may be sought by natural persons resident in Polynesia or legal persons established there, but every beneficiary must be registered there, carry on film or audiovisual production (NAF 5911A or 5911C), and be up to date with tax and social obligations; no age is stated, so a minor's access turns on whether he can be registered as a producer (see companies).

sources.said: Peuvent solliciter une aide au titre du SCCA : les personnes physiques résidant en Polynésie française ; les personnes morales établies en Polynésie française , à l’exclusion : des personnes morales de droit public, des sociétés d’économie mixte. Les bénéficiaires doivent : être immatriculés en Polynésie française ; exercer une activité de production audiovisuelle ou cinématographique (codes NAF 5911A ou 5911C ) ; être à jour de leurs obligations fiscales et sociales ;
